newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Police kill nine thieves in Bogota gunfight.
newsitem.headline: Police kill nine thieves in Bogota gunfight.

text.p: Colombian police killed nine criminals during a two-hour shoot-out in central Bogota on Wednesday evening, a police spokesman said.
The gunfight erupted when police agents tried to intercept a gang as it was robbing a warehouse containing food and household items. One policeman was wounded, the spokesman said.
"The shoot-out went on for about two hours. Nine common criminals died and one of our men was seriously wounded," the police spokesman told Reuters.
"The shooting started inside the warehouse but spilled into the street, but there was no risk to bystanders," he added.
The gang members opened fire on the police using assault rifles, shotguns and automatic pistols, all of which had now been confiscated, the spokesman said.
Last October, police killed seven truck thieves in a southern neighbourhood of Bogota just days after shooting to death six jewelry thieves in the capital.
